additional_info.subject: MY/SiD/MP / ND 170000121/ SECC Coap Polling Error
additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk,
Country: Malaysia
Customer: TNB / KVC Industrial
Sicharge D Serial Number: MP / ND 170000121
Charger both outlet went out of order on 8
th
July 2024 on 6:30am and 11:50am (GMT+8)
Based on the logs pull from last 24 hours at 18:40pm, the logs shows as attached.
Please kindly confirm if it is a SECC Coap Polling Error or the SECC Error code: 69.
Please let us know if we are able to implement the bugfix for this error.
If it is SECC Coap Polling Error, when would the V5.0.16 be released in this week so that we can implement the mitigation for this error.
Thank you.
With best regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0367726-DC/Si-D/MY-[sruJwD]- Charger OutOfOrder CRM:00645000664
additional_info.body:
Hello Edna
,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / ND 170000121
Charger ID/Serial No.:
sruJwD
Problem Description:
Charger Out of Order
We have checked the charger on SCB, but we don't see any logs for the 6 am Malaysian time for July 8th,2024 in there.
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since Dec 7th, 2023
,
as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Vishal Dhiman
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0367726-DC/Si-D/MY-[sruJwD]- Charger OutOfOrder CRM:00645000664
additional_info.body:
Hi Edna,
Hope you’re doing well.
The reason for sending the case back to your queue is that the charger is out of warranty. It was expired on Dec 7th, 2023.
Additionally, there are no logs for the charger between July 5th, 16:45:59, and July 8th, 07:14:37 UTC. To troubleshoot the issue further, you can request the OCPP logs from the CPO backend.
If you need further assistance from the NOC or experts, I suggest contacting Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) to order the remote/ expert support as mentioned in the initial response.
Please let me know if you have any further queries.
Thank you.
Best regards,
Vishal Dhiman
